compliance_standard: FDA eCTD v4.0 Specification (ICH M2 / M4)

dossiers.regulatory_track: Qualified Infectious Disease Product (QIDP) & Fast Track

ectd_module_2_overview.2.4.1_pharmacology: Selectively targets bacterial LpxC (Kd = 2.42 nM) and disrupts outer membrane LPS integrity.
ectd_module_2_overview.2.4.2_pharmacokinetics: Anticipated t1/2 = 4.8h via IV infusion; volume of distribution Vd = 0.42 L/kg.
ectd_module_2_overview.2.4.3_toxicology: No hERG liability (IC50 > 10 uM equivalent); erythrocyte HC50 > 500 ug/mL.

ectd_module_3_cmc.3.2.S_substance: Solid-Phase Peptide Synthesis (SPPS) with 98.5% purity by reverse-phase HPLC.
ectd_module_3_cmc.3.2.P_product: Lyophilized powder in 10 mM sodium phosphate, 5% mannitol (pH 6.8) for reconstitution.
ectd_module_3_cmc.specifications: Endotoxin < 0.2 EU/mg, TFA counterion < 1.0%, peptide content > 85%.

ectd_module_4_nonclinical.primary_pharmacodynamics: In vitro MIC90 = 2.0 ug/mL across 100 clinical MDR isolates.
ectd_module_4_nonclinical.genotoxicity: Ames Salmonella assay negative; chromosomal aberration negative.

dossiers.intended_indication: HER2-Low and Refractory HER2+ Metastatic Breast & Gastric Carcinoma

ectd_module_2_overview.2.4.1_pharmacology: Humanized IgG1 antibody scaffold carrying cytotoxic DM1 via lysosomal GGFG linker (DAR 8).
ectd_module_2_overview.2.4.2_pharmacokinetics: Plasma half-life t1/2 = 8.2 days; low systemic payload deconjugation (< 2.5% free DM1).
ectd_module_2_overview.2.4.3_toxicology: Therapeutic Index TI = 28.7; non-target off-target binding minimized.

ectd_module_3_cmc.3.2.S_substance: Fed-batch CHO cell culture followed by site-specific interchain cysteine conjugation.
ectd_module_3_cmc.3.2.P_product: Sterile concentrate for solution for infusion (100 mg/vial, 20 mg/mL).
ectd_module_3_cmc.specifications: Monomer purity > 97.5% by SEC-HPLC, DAR distribution 7.8 - 8.2.

ectd_module_4_nonclinical.primary_pharmacodynamics: Sub-nanomolar cytotoxicity in HER2+ tumor models (IC50 = 150 pM).
ectd_module_4_nonclinical.safety_pharmacology: Non-human primate tolerability up to 10 mg/kg without ocular or pulmonary toxicity.
ectd_module_4_nonclinical.genotoxicity: Non-cleavable/cleavable hybrid assessment; payload mutagenicity mitigated by targeted delivery.

dossiers.intended_indication: Engineered Probiotic Biosensing of Gut Pathogen Overgrowth
dossiers.regulatory_track: Live Biotherapeutic Product (LBP) Early Phase Regulatory Track

ectd_module_2_overview.2.4.1_pharmacology: E. coli Nissle 1917 chassis expressing pTet-B0034-sfGFP genetic logic cassette.
ectd_module_2_overview.2.4.2_pharmacokinetics: Transient colonization (t1/2 clearance = 48h) with biocontainment kill switch.
ectd_module_2_overview.2.4.3_toxicology: Non-invasive, non-toxigenic chassis compliant with FDA CBER guidance.

ectd_module_3_cmc.3.2.S_substance: High-copy plasmid banking under cGMP conditions; Sanger and NGS sequence identity verification.
ectd_module_3_cmc.3.2.P_product: Enteric-coated capsules containing 1e10 CFU lyophilized engineered Nissle 1917.
ectd_module_3_cmc.specifications: Plasmid retention > 99% across 50 generations without antibiotic selection.

ectd_module_4_nonclinical.primary_pharmacodynamics: 104.2x dynamic range activation in response to target quorum signals.
ectd_module_4_nonclinical.safety_pharmacology: Zero horizontal gene transfer observed in fecal microbiota transfer models.
